mapper.sql: BIN_TO_UUID(p.id) AS problem_id, p.slug, p.code_mode, p.title, p.statement_markdown, p.input_description_markdown, p.output_description_markdown, p.constraints_markdown, p.hint_markdown, p.difficulty, CAST(p.tags_json AS CHAR) AS tags_json, p.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM problem p WHERE p.slug = #{slug} AND p.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(problem_id) AS problem_id, ordinal, input_text, expected_output_text, explanation_markdown FROM problem_sample WHERE problem_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{problemId}) ORDER BY ordinal ASC

SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(problem_id) AS problem_id, language_id, display_order, starter_code FROM problem_language WHERE problem_id IN
UUID_TO_BIN(#{problemId})
ORDER BY problem_id, display_order ASC
